name: getPolicy
description: Look up an insurance policy by policy number. Returns holder, product, period, covered claim types, sum insured and status.

name: findSimilarCases
description: Find other cases on the same policy with an incident date within 3 days of this case. Use it to spot duplicate claims before registering.

name: createCase
description: Register a SUBMITTED claim as a case. Runs the policy coverage checks and records a duplicate if you found one. Moves the case to REGISTERED.

duplicateOfCaseId.description: Case ID this claim duplicates, if findSimilarCases showed a likely duplicate

intakeNotes.description: One or two sentences on what you checked
